pairs.why: A's navy keys sit on the body as soft, tonal bumps like the real calculator, while B's cream keys with dark numerals add many high-contrast edges the real card lacks.
A's gold trim and planks have softer, lower-contrast boundaries close to the real chest, while B has crisper bright highlight rims and a busier edge count.
B has cleaner, simpler contours with fewer edges, whereas A has a dark contour around the lid and a busy patterned background that adds edges the real cards lack.
A's straps and pockets have soft rounded edges and blend tonally like the real backpack, while B has crisper, tighter seams and hardware.
A's thick, saturated orange rim around the blades reads as an outline, while B's rim is thinner and more tonal, closer to the real fins' soft glossy edge.
A's locomotive has fewer fine edges and softer contours, while B adds many small rivets, rail bolts and pipes that push the edge density past the real cards.
A's bezel has soft, rolled highlights and a diffuse shadow like the real clock, while B has crisper thin edges and a hard ground shadow.
A's bezel edges are soft and blend into the background shadow like the real clock, while B's contours are crisper and its floor-shadow edge is hard.
